title: Young Men and Maidens, Raise
description: Young Men and Maidens, Raise in Tonic Solfa to DARWALL, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley wrote these words. His brother John printed them in A Collection of Hymns for the Use of the People Called Methodists (1780), hymn 232.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Hallelujah Metre (6.6.6.6.8.8), and this page sets them to DARWALL; any other Hallelujah Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Young men and maid-ens, raise Your tune-ful voi-ces high; Old men and child-ren, praise The Lord of earth and sky; Him Three in One, and One in Three, Ex-tol to all e-ter-ni-ty.

lines: The Lord of earth and sky;
Him Three in One, and One in Three,
Him Three in One, and One in Three,
Him Three in One, and One in Three,
Of all in earth or heaven!
Him Three in One, and One in Three,

source: John Wesley, A Collection of Hymns for the Use of the People Called Methodists (1780)
licence: Public domain: Charles Wesley died in 1788.
credits: Words by Charles Wesley (1707–1788), public domain, as printed in John Wesley's Collection of Hymns (1780); set to DARWALL by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
